cohort: The study included 64 women with IVF pregnancies conceived through either fresh or frozen embryo transfers who delivered at a tertiary care medical college.
finding: Twin pregnancies, malpresentation, and caesarean delivery were more frequently observed in the frozen embryo transfer (FET) group, particularly due to multiple pregnancies, while maternal and neonatal outcomes were otherwise comparable between fresh and frozen embryo transfers in singleton pregnancies.
mod_finding: Caesarean section and malpresentation were significantly increased in twin pregnancies conceived through frozen embryo transfer.
